BiblicalUsage: Isaiah says the Lord mingled a perverse spirit in the midst of Egypt, so that the nation staggered like a drunken man in his vomit. The word names a twisting of judgment until nothing is straight.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe this one verse shows what happens when a nation turns from God: even its wisdom goes crooked.
